summary: Phase 1 HosPRIME full backend + frontend testing. Backend pytest 26/27 (96%) — single failure is a test-side timing artifact (same-second JWT identical strings), not a backend defect. Frontend smoke covers admin login → dashboard → patients CRUD (Thai search 'สมชาย', allergy alert, vitals, create new patient with auto PAT-000010), appointments page (book dialog opens, status filters), finance RBAC (sidebar shown, no add-patient button), logout, unauthenticated redirect. All critical flows work.

minor.issue: Returned new access_token has identical string to old when called within same second (JWT exp granularity = 1s). Endpoint itself returns 200 and works in real usage. Consider adding 'iat' or 'jti' nonce for guaranteed token uniqueness.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Located in AppointmentsPage.jsx around line 130 — the native <select><option> contains an x-component span wrapper for dynamic text. Cosmetic but pollutes console. Render plain text inside <option>, no nested spans.
a11y warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent}. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to each DialogContent.

action_items: Optional: add iat/jti to JWT payload so refresh always returns a different token string within the same second.
Fix hydration warning in AppointmentsPage.jsx: remove <span> wrapper inside <option> elements (line ~130).
Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to DialogContent components (booking, vitals, edit, add-patient) for a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth: bcrypt hashing ($2b$), httpOnly cookies with samesite=lax, CORS allow_credentials with origins from env — looks correct. Note CORS_ORIGINS default is '*' which combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec; in production set explicit origin list.
secure=False on cookies is OK for preview but must be True in production HTTPS deployment.
Brute-force lockout is keyed on ip:email — verified by inspecting code, not tested live (would have caused 15-min lockout). 5-attempt threshold matches spec.
Seed.seed_admin updates password when env value changes — idempotent and matches playbook.
Patients/appointments routes correctly exclude MongoDB _id from responses.
Soft delete on patients (is_active=False) correctly filters list endpoint.
Appointment double-booking guard excludes cancelled/no_show — verified via pytest (409 returned).
Patient list search uses $regex without escaping — minor risk of malformed regex from user input causing 500. Consider re.escape or text-index.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ patients via API and one front-end patient 'TESTFE AUTO79343' (PAT-000010). Created several test staff users via /api/auth/register (test_xxxx@hosprime.com). Soft-delete on test patient executed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Avoid running login with wrong password >4 times on the same email — lockout=15min/HTTP 429. Appointments page uses native <select> elements (not Radix Select), so UI tests should use page.select_option() / fill instead of looking for role=option. Seed data is created only if patients collection is empty; if you need a fresh state, drop patients/appointments collections and restart backend.
